title: Dashboard api <-> host agent, protocol version 1
description: JSON lines over the agent's unix socket (mode 0660, group casino-agent). The agent first checks the peer's uid/gid against its allowlist. Each request line is at most 65536 bytes; mac is HMAC-SHA256 with the shared agent token over the canonical JSON of the other request fields (sorted keys, separators ',' and ':', ASCII escapes); ts is epoch milliseconds and must be within 30 s of the agent's clock; each id is accepted once. A connection idle for 5 s is closed. A command that runs past its timeout is killed and answered with timeout. Failures carry only a generic code, and the agent closes the connection after bad_request, unauthorized, replayed, too_large and busy. Long-running commands run as jobs: job.start {cmd, args} -> {job_id}; job.get / job.cancel {job_id} -> {job_id, cmd, status, exit_code, started_ms, duration_ms, lines}; job.stream {job_id, from_seq} -> frames, then that body; job.audit {after, limit} -> {records, next}. One mutating job per service: a second mutating job or command gets busy; an unknown job id gets not_found.

id.description: The request's id; null when the request could not be read.

frame.description: One job output line, sent only in answer to job.stream, before its final reply. seq rises by one per line within a job; a gap means old lines left the 5000-line buffer.

line.description: At most 8 KiB, ANSI and control characters removed; a cut line ends with ' [truncated]'.
